### Continually Washed by the Gospel
Author: Daniel R. Hyde
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/articles/continually-washed-gospel
Passage: Exodus 30:17-21
Points:
- Just as bodies require ongoing bathing after birth, believers still need spiritual cleansing after being born again.
- The bronze basin was not a one-time relic but required repeated washing each time priests ministered.
- Christians often wrongly reduce the gospel to an entry-level message intended solely for unbelievers.
- As a kingdom of priests, believers must regularly apply the cleansing power of the gospel to their hearts.
- Christ continues to cleanse His people through His blood, Spirit, and perpetual advocacy before the Father.
